title: 37 C.F.R. § 212.1 — Scope.
creator: U.S. Copyright Office, Library Of Congress
description: Code of Federal Regulations, Title 37 (Patents, Trademarks, and Copyrights), Part 212 (Protection Of Vessel Designs). Text from the eCFR as of 2026-10-26 (unofficial editorial compilation; the official edition is the annual CFR). The provisions of this part apply to the protection and registration of original designs of vessels under chapter 13 of title 17, United States Code. Design protection and registration under this part are separate from copyright protection and registration.
